turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: For orders placed 17 August to 10 October 2026, the average order value (EUR) was 102.66626315789473 EUR for customers who signed up before 2026 (the 2024 signup year, the only earlier year in the data) and 41.0 EUR for customers who signed up in 2026, so the pre-2026 figure is higher by the difference between these two amounts.
